ema.buy: EMA12 > EMA21 and green candle with volume ≥1.5× 20d avg or lower wick ≥40%, close > 20d VWAP
ema.sell: EMA12 closes below EMA21, or 126 sessions

ma200.buy: price > MA200 (≤20% above), within 3% of MA10/MA50, green candle with volume ≥1.5× 20d avg or lower wick ≥40%, close > 20d VWAP

breakout.buy: close > prior 55-day high, green candle with volume ≥1.5× 20d avg or lower wick ≥40%, close > 20d VWAP

squeeze.buy: Bollinger(20,2) width at 120d low, close > upper band, green candle with volume ≥1.5× 20d avg or lower wick ≥40%, close > 20d VWAP

macd.buy: MACD(12,26,9) crosses above signal with close > EMA50, green candle with volume ≥1.5× 20d avg or lower wick ≥40%, close > 20d VWAP

value.buy: 2 closes above 120d value-area high, POC rising 20d, 5d delta > 0, green candle with volume ≥1.5× 20d avg or lower wick ≥40%, close > 20d VWAP

pocbounce.buy: EMA12 > EMA21, close at/just above 120d POC, 5d delta > 0, green candle with volume ≥1.5× 20d avg or lower wick ≥40%, close > 20d VWAP

emaflow.buy: EMA12 > EMA21, 5d delta > 0, close > 120d POC, green candle with volume ≥1.5× 20d avg or lower wick ≥40%, close > 20d VWAP

hvnbreak.buy: close breaks above the high-volume node it sat in, 5d delta > 0, green candle with volume ≥1.5× 20d avg or lower wick ≥40%, close > 20d VWAP

lvnreject.buy: low prints in a low-volume node and close recovers above it, green candle with volume ≥1.5× 20d avg or lower wick ≥40%, close > 20d VWAP
lvnreject.sell: close < that node's floor, or 126 sessions

pocshift.buy: POC rising 5d and 10d, close inside value above POC, 5d delta > 0, green candle with volume ≥1.5× 20d avg or lower wick ≥40%, close > 20d VWAP
pocshift.sell: close < value-area low or POC stalls 10d, or 126 sessions

hlhvn.buy: confirmed higher swing low inside a high-volume node, close > EMA21, 5d delta > 0, green candle with volume ≥1.5× 20d avg or lower wick ≥40%, close > 20d VWAP
hlhvn.sell: close < that swing low, or 126 sessions

smcstruct.buy: close breaks last 10-bar swing high (BOS/CHoCH) with a bullish FVG in the last 20 bars
smcstruct.sell: close < last 10-bar swing low, or 126 sessions

ewabc.buy: A-B-C pullback completes as a higher low and close breaks the interior high
ewabc.sell: close < last confirmed swing low, or 126 sessions
